title: From the top 10 networks with the most DOWN ports, list each network ID and
question: From the top 10 networks with the most DOWN ports, list each network ID and its DOWN-port count, and for each DOWN port show the port ID, tenant ID, port name, MAC address, device owner, allocated IP address, binding host, VIF type, the port’s row number within its network (ordered by port ID), and the port’s rank within the DOWN status group (ordered by port ID). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    p.network_id,
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.name AS port_name,
    p.mac_address,
    p.device_owner,
    ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address,
    pb.host AS binding_host,
    pb.vif_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.network_id ORDER BY p.id) AS port_row_number_in_network,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.id) AS port_rank_in_down_status_group
  FROM ports p
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
  LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings pb ON p.id = pb.port_id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
network_down_counts AS (
  SELECT network_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count
  FROM down_ports
  GROUP BY network_id
  ORDER BY down_port_count DESC, network_id ASC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  ndc.network_id,
  ndc.down_port_count,
  dp.port_id,
  dp.tenant_id,
  dp.port_name,
  dp.mac_address,
  dp.device_owner,
  dp.allocated_ip_address,
  dp.binding_host,
  dp.vif_type,
  dp.port_row_number_in_network,
  dp.port_rank_in_down_status_group
FROM network_down_counts ndc
JOIN down_ports dp ON ndc.network_id = dp.network_id
ORDER BY ndc.down_port_count DESC, ndc.network_id ASC, dp.port_id ASC
